pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp, non-smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries and high spatial density across the visible rump and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, continuous light-colored pathways forming a highly connected topological graph with frequent tri-axial junction nodes.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of approximately seven dark-colored avian organisms (oxpeckers) distributed across the dorsal ridge, rump, and lateral surfaces.
